# School Drone (學校無人機)

> A free browser game for kids, in English and Traditional Chinese. Kids fly a school drone inside a library. A robot teacher inside the drone explains each move in simple words.

- Play: https://ultralabed.github.io/School-Drone/
- Play in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文): https://ultralabed.github.io/School-Drone/zh/
- Source code: https://github.com/ultralabed/School-Drone
- Idea: Aaron Shih
- Built by: Edward Shih (https://www.linkedin.com/in/edward-shih-43942786)
- License: MIT

## What kids learn

- Faster propellers push more air down, and the drone goes up.
- The drone leans to move left or right.
- Hover means staying still in the air.
- A good pilot lands before the battery is empty. Three batteries let kids take turns.
- Keep drones away from people, walls and bookshelves.
- Quadcopters, hexacopters, helicopters and jets fly in different ways.
- Bees dance in a figure 8 to show where flowers are.
